en: The postcard features a collage of four images. The top left image shows a white colonial or neoclassical building with symmetrical architecture, flanked by tall trees. The other three images show museum displays of taxidermy African wildlife: a lion attacking a zebra, a group of lions attacking a buffalo, and a group of giraffes. In the center, bold text reads 'MUSEU ÁLVARO DE CASTRO.'
